WE ARE HIRING! ZTE Indonesia INTERNSHIP PROGRAM 2026

Looking for an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop your professional skills? Join ZTE Indonesia's Internship Program 2026!

We are opening an opportunity for: Operation Support Intern
📍 Location: South Jakarta
⏳ Duration: 6 Months

Who Can Apply?
Currently enrolled university students who are eager to learn, grow, and gain practical work experience.

Interested? Scan the QR code on the poster and submit your application!

JOB DESCRIPTION
• Responsible for daily support to Finance and Admin departments, assisting

REQUIREMENTS
• Currently enrolled in a university, pursuing a degree in related fields.
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Good communication and interpersonal abilities.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
•Willingness to learn and adapt to new tasks.
• Available to join the internship as soon as possible for 6-months period.
